in_marathi.name: Ekagraksh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Single-visioned, one-pointed focus
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekagraksh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ekagraksh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘eka’ meaning ‘one’ and ‘akrsh’ meaning ‘vision’. This name is bestowed upon those who possess a single-minded focus and unwavering vision. In Hindu mythology, Ekagraksh is associated with the god Shiva, who is known for his intense concentration and unwavering focus.
